summary: In this replication stage, the agent formulated a pre-registered plan, configured an isolated virtual environment, downloaded the public MUSE vectors and SemEval datasets, and built a thorough verification pipeline. It successfully replicated the Spanish monolingual results (exact 3.6918 Original MWEAT, 0.3885 cosine, 0.9140/0.8258 accuracies) while demonstrating that the reported ES Shift Ori number depends on a parenthesization bug in doPCA. It diagnosed the bilingual evaluation as blocked due to missing unreleased aligned vectors, showing that public MUSE vectors cap at P@1 ~52-56 rather than the reported 79.2. However, it accepted the mitigation's bias-reduction claim at face value, missing the circularity of post-Shift MWEAT evaluation and the uninformative nature of the permutation p-values.
